milestone: Falsify the R34-C2 honest stop, its counterexample evidence, the five record defects and the proposed fresh-content repair
context:
# Goal
kaidoku round 34 (run-6 re-dispatch), wave 2: falsify the round's own stop. Lane repo /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin.

The L1 declared R34-C2 (a pre-freeze shortcut-replay gate, claimed capability acquisition on axis depth) stopped: frozen at c79bbe7b, the six frozen clauses held, but wave-1 seats produced structure-blind readers that meet the GREEN counter's target without walking records — content-multiset (`.ufo/waves/round-34/r34b/w1/CtlMultiset-files/nameset.py`, 8/8, three seeds), payload-keyed (8/8, names zeroed), and others. The stop record is `.ufo/waves/round-34/r34b/claim-stop.json` (landed cd75b92e). Your job is to attack that stop, the evidence behind it, and the record defects — not to reopen the claim, not to repair frozen instruments, not to award any score.

# Hard rules
- Absolute paths only, under /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin or your own `/fast/scratch/hyaku/kaidoku-r34b/w2/<YourSeat>/`. Never write the fleet root, sibling lanes, /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokuknow, ~/.omp, ~/.config, ~/.kimi-code.
- Read-only on lane VCS: no git add/commit/stash/checkout/reset/pull/push, no mutating jj command. Clone or copy into scratch to run anything.
- Never execute an ELF carrier, fixture or reader as a program of interest; readers run only as python via a counter. Do not execute the R34-C1 production reader or its twelve carriers.
- Do not edit the frozen instruments (`tools/round-34/*`), `claims.json`, `claim-stop.json`, or any corpus/SCORECARD/LOG/SKILL doc. Drafts go in your report; the L1 lands.
- Tooling: installs allowed (read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first; record tool/version/channel/reason). pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide: `uv tool`/`npx`/official binary in ~/.local/bin only; never pacman -S/-Sy/-Syu/-U/-R; never restart a host service.
- An unrun check has not passed. Report exact argv, exit codes and UTC. Never fabricate. Never use agent://all.
